artboards.title: B · Settings beside the respondent panel
C · Summary row, details on demand

annotations.text:
Objects on the map — settings block in the question modal. Three directions, DM Sans + editor tokens (#4f46e5 accent, 8px radii, #e5e7eb card border).
A: one vertical story — layer → panel → ask about objects; status pill says whether it collects.
B: settings on the left, a live picture of the respondent panel on the right; 'Other respondents see' offered for any layer.
C: the whole block collapses to a summary row with pills; sub-question types offered as one-tap chips.

Creator journey after giving every setting back to its owner (journey.md).
Source settings (label field, approve-first) sit under the picker and only for 'Respondents’ marks on…'.
What other respondents see is a switch on each sub-question — 👍/👎 → counts, text → comments — and works for uploaded layers too.
Status pill + Minimum objects follow the sub-questions, not the layer.
